_comment: FICTIONAL EXAMPLE. Phrases the deterministic proofreader flags in the compiled resume text. severity=error blocks delivery; warn asks a reviewer to confirm. Case-insensitive Python regexes. Keep in sync with the ownership boundaries in rules.md.

rules.message: Sole-ownership language contradicts the ownership boundaries in rules.md.
Ranking-model training was owned by another engineer; only the feature pipeline and evaluation harness are claimable.
LLM evaluation became org-wide; 'designed the initial service' is safe, owning it is not.
The Contoso deployment platform was a team effort: say 'contributed to'.
